title: Yara and the Archive
author: Dominic Galloway
blurb: Sebastian Blackwood, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
